idea.description: The insight, quote, or principle, in your own words or theirs.
idea.example: e.g. You don't rise to your goals; you fall to your systems.

title.description: Optional. A short handle for this idea.

synthesis.description: The thread you see running through the ones you've chosen.
synthesis.example: e.g. All three are really about lowering the cost of starting.

makeItMine.description: Your own take — what you've observed, how it fits your life.
makeItMine.example: e.g. For me this shows up as: prepare the space the night before.
